card.statement:
The projective complexes $T^{i}(P^{\bullet}_{e_1})$, $T^{i}(P^{\bullet}_{e_2})$, $T^{i}(P^{\bullet}_{\a})$, $T^{i}(P^{\bullet}_{\b})$, $T^{i}(P^{\bullet}_{(\b\a)^{s}})$,

$T^{i}(P^{\bullet}_{\a(\b\a)^{s}})$, $T^{i}(P^{\bullet}_{(\b\a)^{s}\b})$ and $T^{i}(P^{\bullet}_{\a(\b\a)^{s}\b})$, where $i\in \Z$, $s\in \N$, constitute an exhaustive list of pairwise non-isomorphic indecomposable objects of ${\bf D}^{b}(A_2)$.
card.label: Theorem 3

paper.title: Derived categories of Schur algebras
paper.abstract: We classify the derived tame Schur and infinitesimal Schur algebras and describe indecomposable objects in their derived categories.
